title: revlens change log
description: docs/changes/<version>/changes.json in the engagement repository: the instructions that produced one version of the document. One entry becomes one revision in the bundle, and its verbatim text is what the viewer shows behind a change.

version.description: Version of the document these instructions produced

id.description: Id of the instruction; the bundle links back to it as origin

received.description: Local wall-clock time the instruction arrived. Its calendar day joins the entry to a commit when revision is absent, so it must be the day the change was committed.

revision.description: Commit the instruction was carried out in. The exact join, and the one to use when the change log lives in the same repository as the chapters; otherwise leave it out and the adapter joins by target path and day.

summary.description: What was asked, one line; becomes the revision title

verbatim.description: The instruction as it was given, never rewritten

changes.description: What the instruction changed. A target naming a chapter file is what ties the entry to that chapter.

target.description: Path of the file changed, relative to the analysis repository root

why.description: A comment id mentioned here (K<round>-<number>) makes the revision a comment resolution
